nodes.name: CODEOWNERS
nodes.summary: Assigns default code owners for the web, Tauri, and desktop packages to specific maintainers so GitHub automatically requests their review on pull requests touching those paths.

nodes.name: TEAM_MEMBERS
nodes.summary: Plain roster of core team GitHub usernames used as a reference by repository automation such as code ownership and review routing.

nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Reusable composite GitHub Action that installs Bun pinned to the packageManager version in package.json, restores the Bun package cache keyed on bun.lock, and runs bun install (with a hoisted-linker workaround for patched dependencies on Windows).
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back to an x64-baseline Bun download URL on X64 runners and uses actions/cache@v4 keyed by hashFiles('**/bun.lock') with a per-OS restore key.

nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Composite GitHub Action that mints a GitHub App installation token via actions/create-github-app-token, configures the <slug>[bot] git committer identity, clears the checkout auth header, and re-points the origin remote to an authenticated x-access-token URL.

nodes.name: publish-python-sdk.yml
nodes.summary: Fully commented-out GitHub Actions workflow for generating the Python SDK from the OpenAPI spec and publishing it to PyPI on release; kept only as a placeholder pending a move to its final location.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: Pull request template enforcing a structured checklist: linked issue, change type, a description section that warns against pasted AI-generated boilerplate, verification steps, and screenshots for UI changes.

nodes.name: .gitleaksignore
nodes.summary: Allowlist of fake secret-looking fixture strings for gitleaks, pinned to exact commit:file:rule:line locations in the http-recorder record/replay tests so redaction-test data does not trip secret scanning.

nodes.name: pre-push
nodes.summary: Git pre-push hook that verifies the local Bun version satisfies the packageManager semver range from package.json before running the repo-wide typecheck, blocking the push on any failure.

nodes.name: .prettierignore
nodes.summary: Excludes SST's generated sst-env.d.ts and the desktop bindings file from Prettier formatting.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Zed editor workspace settings enabling format-on-save by piping buffers through Prettier via bunx.

nodes.name: flake.nix
nodes.summary: Nix flake providing a devShell with Bun, Node.js 20, and build tooling across four platforms, plus overlays and packages that build the opencode CLI and desktop app from the ./nix derivations (including a fakeHash updater derivation to discover correct hashes).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nixpkgs.lib.genAttrs over four systems for per-platform outputs and callPackage wiring for the node_modules -> opencode -> desktop derivation chain.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point of the standalone opencode GitHub Action: on /opencode or /oc issue/PR comments it spawns an `opencode serve` instance, exchanges an OIDC token for a GitHub App token, builds a prompt from issue/PR context with image attachments, runs an agent chat session, and pushes the resulting commits, branches, or PRs back to GitHub.
nodes.languageNotes: Script-style top-level orchestration with module-level mutable state and hoisted function declarations; talks to the opencode server through the generated @opencode-ai/sdk v2 client while manually parsing the /event SSE stream.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Release helper that finds the latest github-v* semver tag and re-points the movable `latest` tag at it, deleting and re-pushing the tag on origin.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Release helper that bumps the github-v* patch version (or minor with --minor), tags it, and pushes the tag to trigger a new GitHub Action release build.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: SST-generated ambient type shim for the github/ directory that references the root sst-env.d.ts and imports the `sst` module for infrastructure type context.

nodes.name: app.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for the public API surface: a Cloudflare Worker (the packages/function API with a SyncServer durable object) on api.<domain>, plus the Astro docs site on docs.<domain> and the static web app on app.<domain>.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SST/Pulumi ambient globals ($app, $resolve) with no imports; the SyncServer durable object binding is appended via a transform hook with migration tags that vary by stage.

nodes.name: console.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for the console: a PlanetScale database with per-stage branches and passwords, a Cloudflare Worker auth API linked to GitHub/Google OAuth secrets, Stripe billing resources (products, prices, coupons, webhook endpoint), and a SolidStart console app wired to dozens of linked secrets and a log-processor tail consumer.
nodes.languageNotes: Composed entirely from SST/Pulumi ambient globals (sst, planetscale, stripe, $app, $dev); the ZEN_MODELS config is sharded across 30 separate sst.Secret values.

nodes.name: enterprise.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for the enterprise Teams app: a SolidStart site on the short opncd.ai domain backed by an R2 bucket, using the r2 storage adapter with linked access-key secrets.

nodes.name: monitoring.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for Honeycomb alerting: a Discord webhook recipient plus five triggers watching model and provider HTTP error rates for the Go and Zen tiers and free-tier request spikes.
nodes.languageNotes: Query specs are built with honeycomb.getQuerySpecificationOutput and embedded as JSON in trigger definitions; error-rate formulas gate on a minimum sample count to suppress noisy alerts.

nodes.name: secret.ts
nodes.summary: Declares shared SST secrets (R2 access keys) and a random 24-character Honeycomb webhook secret, and teaches sst.Linkable how to wrap random.RandomPassword resources.

nodes.name: stage.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves per-stage domains (opencode.ai and opncd.ai plus their dev and stage-prefixed variants), exports the Cloudflare zone ID, and registers a regional hostname for the stage domain.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: curl|bash installer for the opencode binary: detects OS/arch (including Rosetta translation, AVX2 baseline fallback, and musl variants), downloads the matching release archive with a custom ASCII progress bar, installs to ~/.opencode/bin, and updates the shell config PATH.
nodes.languageNotes: Progress rendering pipes curl --trace-ascii through a named FIFO and parses received-byte lines with an unbuffered sed variant; falls back to plain curl -# on Windows or non-TTY environments.

nodes.name: createOpencode
nodes.summary: Spawns `opencode serve` bound to 127.0.0.1:4096 and returns an SDK client pointed at it, with a close() helper that kills the child process.

nodes.name: getReviewCommentContext
nodes.summary: Extracts file, line, diff hunk, and commit anchors from a pull_request_review_comment payload, returning null for any other event type.

nodes.name: assertOpencodeConnected
nodes.summary: Polls the spawned opencode server up to 30 times at 300ms intervals and throws if it never becomes reachable.

nodes.name: useEnvModel
nodes.summary: Parses the MODEL env var into providerID and modelID components, throwing when it is unset or not in provider/model format.

nodes.name: getAccessToken
nodes.summary: Resolves the GitHub token: the TOKEN env var when set, otherwise exchanges an OIDC ID token (or a mock PAT in dev) for a GitHub App installation token via api.opencode.ai.

nodes.name: createComment
nodes.summary: Posts a '[Working...]' placeholder comment linked to the action run URL on the triggering issue.

nodes.name: getUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user prompt from the comment body (bare /opencode summarizes the thread; review comments inject diff context) and downloads github.com/user-attachments assets, rewriting them to @file references with base64-encoded prompt files.

nodes.name: subscribeSessionEvents
nodes.summary: Opens the /event SSE stream and pretty-prints the session's completed tool executions (color-coded per tool) and finished text parts to the action log while tracking session metadata updates.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Asks the model to compress its full response into under 40 characters for a commit or PR title, falling back to the issue title (or a fixed string for scheduled runs) on failure.

nodes.name: resolveAgent
nodes.summary: Validates the AGENT env var against the server's registered agents and falls back to the default agent when the name is unknown or refers to a subagent.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Sends the prompt (plus inline base64 file parts) to the opencode session with the configured model and agent, returning the last text part of the response.

nodes.name: configureGit
nodes.summary: Backs up the local git http extraheader, replaces it with a basic-auth app token credential, and sets the global committer identity to opencode-agent[bot]; skipped in mock runs.

nodes.name: checkoutForkBranch
nodes.summary: Adds the PR head repository as the `fork` remote, shallow-fetches the head branch, and checks it out under a generated local branch name.

nodes.name: pushToNewBranch
nodes.summary: Commits all changes with the model-generated summary and a Co-authored-by trailer for the triggering actor, then pushes the new issue branch to origin.

nodes.name: pushToLocalBranch
nodes.summary: Commits all changes with a co-authored trailer and pushes directly to the currently checked-out local PR branch.

nodes.name: pushToForkBranch
nodes.summary: Commits all changes and pushes HEAD back to the fork's remote branch so the contribution lands in the contributor's own repository.

nodes.name: assertPermissions
nodes.summary: Verifies the triggering actor has admin or write collaborator permission before the agent acts, skipping the check entirely when a personal TOKEN env var is supplied.

nodes.name: updateComment
nodes.summary: Overwrites the placeholder comment with the final response body and footer links.

nodes.name: createPR
nodes.summary: Opens a pull request from the issue branch to the default branch with the title truncated to 256 characters, returning the new PR number.

nodes.name: footer
nodes.summary: Renders the markdown footer appended to every comment: an optional social-card share image, the session share link, and the GitHub run link.

nodes.name: fetchIssue
nodes.summary: Queries the GitHub GraphQL API for the issue's title, body, author, state, and up to 100 comments.

nodes.name: buildPromptDataForIssue
nodes.summary: Serializes an issue and its prior comments into an XML-tagged context block, excluding the action's own placeholder and trigger comments.

nodes.name: fetchPR
nodes.summary: Queries the GitHub GraphQL API for a pull request including commits, changed files, issue comments, and nested review threads with inline comments.

nodes.name: buildPromptDataForPR
nodes.summary: Serializes a pull request — metadata, prior comments, changed files with diff stats, and review threads — into XML-tagged context sections for the prompt.

nodes.name: revokeAppToken
nodes.summary: Deletes the GitHub installation token on exit so the minted credential does not outlive the action run.

nodes.name: modelHttpErrorsQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a Honeycomb query spec computing the per-model HTTP error rate for a product tier (the Go tier excludes 401 and 429), gated on at least 100 requests over a 15-minute window.

nodes.name: providerHttpErrorsQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a Honeycomb query spec computing the per-provider error rate by comparing completions successes against llm.error failures, gated on at least 50 samples over 15 minutes.

nodes.name: usage
nodes.summary: Prints the installer's help text with curl|bash usage examples and the available options.

nodes.name: print_message
nodes.summary: Echoes a color-coded message to the terminal based on the info/warning/error level.

nodes.name: check_version
nodes.summary: Skips the install early when an existing opencode binary on PATH already reports the requested version.

nodes.name: unbuffered_sed
nodes.summary: Returns a sed invocation using the best available unbuffered mode (-u, -l, or a 512-byte line-padding fallback) so the progress parser sees curl trace lines in real time.

nodes.name: print_progress
nodes.summary: Renders a 50-cell ASCII progress bar (filled with ■ and ･) with a percentage derived from bytes downloaded versus content length.

nodes.name: download_with_progress
nodes.summary: Downloads the release archive with curl --trace-ascii through a named FIFO, feeding parsed received-byte lines to the progress bar, with cursor restoration and temp-file cleanup handled by a RETURN trap.

nodes.name: download_and_install
nodes.summary: Downloads the platform archive (progress bar with a plain-curl fallback on Windows or non-TTY), extracts the tar.gz or zip, and moves the binary into ~/.opencode/bin with mode 0755.

nodes.name: add_to_path
nodes.summary: Appends the PATH export (or fish_add_path) line to a shell config file once, skipping when the command is already present or the file is not writable.
